converted_catalyst_copy.ui: Accessibility and visual inspection showed 'Hello from iOS ARM64' and 'iOS app on Mac: NO'

playcover_research.finding: Normal installation rewrites LC_BUILD_VERSION to PLATFORM_MACCATALYST (6), so it cannot preserve the platform-2 binary for this experiment.

conclusion: The platform-2 binary was produced and inspected but did not launch directly. Only the separately converted platform-6 Catalyst copy was observed opening. This does not demonstrate native iOS-on-Mac execution or prove that macOS can run iOS binaries directly.
